item.description:
ATEEZ 2025 WORLD TOUR [IN YOUR FANTASY] IN JAPAN [WOWOW] (1080p HD)​


​
ATEEZ, who released their JAPAN 2ND FULL ALBUM "Ashes to Light" in September 2025 and have been generating a lot of buzz, are featured in this report on their arena tour that took them to three cities in Japan, specifically their performance at Saitama Super Arena in September of the same year. In 2024, they became the first K-POP boy group to perform at Coachella, one of America's largest music festivals, and also held their first stadium concert in North America at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles. Furthermore, they took to the stage of Citi Field in New York, where world-renowned musicians have performed, and demonstrated their unparalleled presence to the world with their unique performance. This time, with unwavering confidence, they embarked on another tour, starting in Incheon, South Korea, and continuing through North America and Japan. As this was ATEEZ's largest world tour to date, with seven performances in three cities in Japan—a first for the group—they were more anticipated than ever before.
